documents.title: Clarification sought from Advance Agrolife Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Advance Agrolife Limited reported its highest ever quarterly performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue reaching 3,304 million rupees and a net profit of 225.5 million rupees, representing a 152% year-on-year increase. Management highlighted that the company's strategic focus on backward integration, expanding technical manufacturing capacities, and leveraging its portfolio of CIB & RC registrations is driving structural margin improvements. The company aims to increase its export share to 20% of revenue by FY29 and is expanding production infrastructure with new facilities like Unit-4 and Unit-5. Furthermore, the firm benefits from a geographic inland arbitrage near major agrochemical consuming states and maintains a sticky B2B customer base. Advance Agrolife Limited reported its financial and operational results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its export revenue share from approximately 2% to 20% by FY29.
guidance.quote: We are aggressively targeting an increase in our export revenue share from a negligible 2% today to 20% by FY29.

guidance.claim: Management targets to commence operations at the new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27.
guidance.quote: • AAL aims to commence operations at our new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27, with an estimated first-phase capital expenditure of approximately ₹ 250 million.

demand_outlook.claim: Q3 FY26 income increased on the back of increased demand and new customer additions.
demand_outlook.quote: • AAL’s Q3 FY26 Income at ₹ 1338 million increased by 18% Y-o-Y on the back of increased demand and addition of new customers.

capex_expansion.claim: AAL aims to commence operations at its new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27 with an estimated first-phase capital expenditure of approximately ¥250 million.
capex_expansion.quote: AAL aims to commence operations at our new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27, with an estimated first-phase capital expenditure of approximately ¥ 250 million.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant to increase renewable energy usage and reduce its carbon footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: AAL is in the process of setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant with the objective of increasing the use of renewable energy and reducing its carbon footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into an MOU for land acquisition to set up Unit-5 at Dahej II GIDC Industrial Estate, Bharuch, Gujarat for manufacturing technical grade pesticides.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has entered into an MOU for acquisition of land admeasuring 17,491.02 sq. mtrs. for setting up a new plant, proposed to be named Unit-5, situated at Dahej II GIDC Industrial Estate, Bharuch, Gujrat for manufacturing of technical grade pesticides.

capex_expansion.claim: The company set up a new R&D laboratory and is in the process of setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: • AAL set up a new R&D laboratory focused on developing innovative product combinations and strengthening our long-term product pipeline. AAL is in the process of setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant to increase the use of renewable energy and reduce its carbon footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is considering setting up manufacturing facilities for Pretilachlor and PEDA with capacities of about 13 tonnes per day and 10 tonnes per day respectively.
capex_expansion.quote: • The company is considering setting up of manufacturing facilities for Pretilachlor and PEDA, with installed production capacities of about 13 tonnes per day and 10 tonnes per day respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations at the new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani are aimed to commence by Q2 FY27 with an estimated first-phase capex of approximately ₹250 million.
capex_expansion.quote: • AAL aims to commence operations at our new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27, with an estimated first-phase capital expenditure of approximately ₹ 250 million.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was steady at 10.6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for Q1 were steady at 10.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 EBITDA stood at ₹73.5 million with an EBITDA margin of 5.5%.
margins_costs.quote: • EBITDA for Q3 FY26 at ₹ 73.5 million increased by 16% Y-o-Y; and EBIDTA for 9M FY26 rose by 20%. EBITDA margin for Q3 and 9M were 5.5% and 9.8% respectively.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for 9M FY26 was reported at 9.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for Q3 and 9M were 5.5% and 9.8% respectively.

The company has an installed capacity of nearly 90,000 MTPA.
